### Academic Website Template

An open-source Quarto template for building a professional academic website — free, no coding experience required, and deployable to GitHub Pages in under an hour. This site was built with it!

::: project-tags

<script>
(async function() {
  try {
    const response = await fetch('/data/software.json?v=20261121');
    if (!response.ok) return;
    const records = await response.json();
    const software = records.find(record => /Variable Explorer$/i.test(record.title));
    const index = records.find(record => /variable index/i.test(record.title));
    if (software) document.querySelector('#software-doi')?.setAttribute('href', `https://doi.org/${software.doi}`);
    if (index) document.querySelector('#variable-index-doi')?.setAttribute('href', `https://doi.org/${index.doi}`);
  } catch (_) {}
})();
</script>
